# PixelPress — Compress JPG to 20KB Online

> PixelPress is a free, browser-based JPG compressor for strict upload limits such as 20KB. Choose a JPG, pick a target size, and download a smaller image without login, payment, or server upload.

PixelPress is one page, https://compressimageto20kb.online/. Compression runs inside the browser with the Canvas API, so the selected JPG is never uploaded to a server and the result is downloaded directly from the tab. The tool accepts JPG/JPEG files only, up to 50MB each, and never asks for an account.

Target-size presets: 10KB, 20KB, 30KB, 40KB, 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, 500KB, 1MB and 2MB. Quality modes: Balanced quality (default), Keep more detail, and Prefer smaller output. Several JPG files can be compressed in one run and collected together with Download ZIP.

Every result is reported as Target reached, Closest match, or Already under target. A very detailed photo may not reach a tiny target without visible damage, so the tool returns the closest clean result instead of a broken image. The page has no login, pricing, checkout, or support pages.

## Core pages
- [PixelPress JPG compressor](https://compressimageto20kb.online/): the whole tool lives on this single page: upload panel, target sizes, quality settings, guide, FAQ and downloads.

## Tool sections
- [Upload and file list](https://compressimageto20kb.online/#compressor): choose or drop JPG files, run Compress All, download single results or a ZIP.
- [Target-size presets](https://compressimageto20kb.online/#sizes): switch between the ten presets from 10KB to 2MB without leaving the page.
- [Why compress JPG to 20KB](https://compressimageto20kb.online/#why): when a strict 20KB limit helps and how the compressor trades detail for size.
- [JPG compression guide](https://compressimageto20kb.online/#guide): 16 short sections on target size, source preparation, privacy, quality modes and result status.
- [Feature highlights](https://compressimageto20kb.online/#features): browser based, fast downloads, help built in, private by design.
- [JPG compressor FAQ](https://compressimageto20kb.online/#faq): 8 questions on uploads, batch compression, supported file types, quality and cost.
